title: Swarm - Data API
description: Represents a team of agents, Salesforce users, or Slack users in a Slack channel or thread dedicated to solving a problem. This problem can be related to a support case, incident, sales opportunity, or change request. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

CollaborationRoomId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CollaborationRoomId.description: ID of the collaboration room. This field is a relationship field.

CollaborationTool.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CollaborationTool.description: Tool used for swarming. Possible values are: None Slack The default value is None.

CollaborationUrl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CollaborationUrl.description: URL of the Slack channel or thread.

EndedDateTime.description: Date and time the swarm ended.

HelpNeeded.description: Short description of the problem that the swarm is trying to solve.

IsDedicatedChannel.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsDedicatedChannel.description: Indicates if the swarm is happening in a dedicated channel (true) or in an existing channel (false). The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: Timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: Timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

MessageKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MessageKey.description: ID of the Slack thread or message.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the swarm owner. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

RelatedRecordId.description: ID of the record the swarm’s problem is related to. The record can be of, for example, a case, incident, sales opportunity, or change request. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
RelatedRecordId.refers_to: Account, Case, ChangeRequest, Incident, Opportunity, Problem, User

StartedDateTime.description: Date and time the swarm started.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
Status.description: Status of the swarm. Possible values are: Closed In Progress New Waiting (Custom) The default value is New.

UsageType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
UsageType.description: Type of swarm. Possible values are: CareMgmt—Care Coordination DealRoom—Sales Channel PartnerChannel—Partner Account Channel Swarming The default value is Swarming.

special_access_rules: To access this object for swarming in Salesforce, enable the Run Flows and Service Cloud User user permissions. For swarming in Slack, connect Salesforce to Slack and enable the Run Flows and Slack Service User user permissions.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **SwarmFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **SwarmHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **SwarmOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **SwarmShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
